vendor: Roblox GUI Maker (operating legal entity not publicly disclosed on the site)
product_family: Single AI-powered web tool that generates Roblox Studio GUI mockup images and a structured component plan from a text prompt (shops, HUDs, inventory, admin panels, reward popups, obby UI, mobile layouts); offered as Free / Creator ($12/mo) / Studio ($39/mo) credit-based tiers. Explicitly an unofficial third-party tool: 'Not affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation.'

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. The captured homepage (the only page the vendor's own site allowed automated access to) contains no mention of SOC 2, and no independent source or trust center could be found.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No mention of ISO 27001 on the homepage or in any independently discoverable vendor material.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: No explicit GDPR compliance statement could be confirmed. A 'Privacy Policy' link exists in the site footer, but the page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch attempts (tried /privacy, /privacy-policy, /legal/privacy) so its contents could not be verified.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence, and not applicable to this product's function (Roblox GUI mockup generation does not involve health data).

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: The site states 'Secure checkout by Stripe' — payment card handling is delegated to Stripe (Stripe holds PCI DSS Level 1 certification as a processor), but this is the payment processor's certification, not the vendor's own. No vendor-held PCI DSS evidence found.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor's site or via search.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No AI-governance certification claims found anywhere in captured content.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor's site or via search.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable to a small consumer-facing creator tool with no government-market positioning.

privacy.ai_training_note: Unknown. The product generates images by calling what the homepage describes only as 'a paid model' (the underlying AI/image-generation provider is not named). Whether user prompts or generated outputs are used for model training, and whether an opt-out exists, could not be confirmed: the site's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages exist (linked in the footer: 'Privacy Policy', 'Terms of Service', 'Refund & Cancellation') but returned HTTP 403 to every automated fetch attempt, so their text could not be read for this assessment.

security.name: Payment processing
security.value: Checkout is handled by Stripe ('Secure checkout by Stripe'; 'Credits added after checkout'). No evidence the vendor stores raw card data itself.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Not explicitly stated on the vendor's public marketing page. Site is served over HTTPS at robloxguimaker.dev, but no explicit vendor statement about encryption in transit/at rest was found.

security.name: Data retention / storage
security.value: No public evidence. Privacy Policy page exists per footer link but could not be retrieved (403 to automated fetch).

security.name: Third-party AI model dependency
security.value: 'Real AI generation is gated by sign-in, credits, and plan controls before it can call a paid model.' The underlying AI/image-generation provider is not named on the page, so its own compliance posture cannot be assessed here.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Public/anonymous mode uses 'safe preview generation'; full generation requires sign-in and paid credits. No further detail (e.g., MFA, SSO) is published.

products.name: Roblox GUI Maker (Free / Creator / Studio tiers)
products.category: AI-generated Roblox Studio GUI mockup tool
products.data_scope: User text prompts describing desired UI screens, account/auth info, and payment/billing details processed via Stripe. No evidence the product handles sensitive personal data (health, financial account numbers, government IDs) beyond standard account and billing info.
products.notes: Free: 10 credits (~2 full generations), no card required. Creator ($12/mo): 150 credits/30 generations/mo, unlimited project saves, email support. Studio ($39/mo): 500 credits/100 generations/mo, priority speed, bulk export, team use, priority support. Single product surface across tiers; no separate enterprise, self-hosted, or API-only offering found.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium, credit-based subscription: Free (10 credits) / Creator $12/mo (150 credits) / Studio $39/mo (500 credits); billed via Stripe, cancel anytime.

flags: No trust center and no certification claims of any kind found anywhere in the available content; this is consistent with a small, likely solo-developer/indie tool rather than an over-claim, but it also means AI-training posture, data residency, DPA availability, and retention could not be confirmed either way.

Underlying AI/image-generation model provider is not disclosed by name ('a paid model'), so that subprocessor's own security/compliance posture is unknown and out of scope of any vendor-held certification.

A different, similarly named site (robloxguimaker.com) exists and surfaced in search results; this assessment covers ONLY robloxguimaker.dev per the evidence file's url field — do not merge or conflate certs/coverage between the two domains.

No legal entity name (Inc./LLC) is disclosed on the site; only the brand name 'Roblox GUI Maker' and a support email (support@robloxguimaker.dev) were found, so the vendor field above is a best-effort description, not a confirmed legal name.
